cohort: Data from 107,034 singleton births in Hawai'i from 2003-2008.
finding: Asthma, diabetes, and high blood pressure are associated with higher hospital delivery charges and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Diabetes and high blood pressure were also associated with Caesarean delivery.
birth_weight: low birth weight (<2500 grams), high birth weight (>4500 grams)
